_comment: Egress allow list per jailed MCP server (ADR-028, WS-SEC-003, WS-AI-011), read by ws-mcp-jail and ws-egress-proxy at every server start. A server registered with jail.egress has no network of its own: it reaches only the hosts listed here, through ws-egress-proxy. mode: enforce (anything else is refused, 403) | audit (everything passes and what is not listed is logged as would-deny: build the list, then enforce) | off (shared network, as before). Hosts: exact names or *.domain; ports 443 and 80 unless the entry names one. See what a server really reached with: ws-egress-proxy report NAME. Yours to edit in a plain shell or from Menu > Settings; Claude cannot (guard.sh).
